period_note: Half-Yearly (Jan-Jun) filing used as the Q2 data point per project convention. Standalone (solo) basis, from the bank's own 'Condensed Balance Sheet (Unaudited)'/'Condensed Profit and Loss Account (Unaudited)' (distinct from the 'Condensed Consolidated' statements printed earlier in the same filing). Matches the basis of this bank's own 2021-2025 Q4/annual series (solo). Income-statement items use the 'Cumulative Jan to June 2021' column; the filing also separately discloses a discrete 'Quarter ended April to June 2021' column (interest income 5,504,372,340; PAT 1,438,894,274; EPS 1.03) not recorded here. Balance sheet identity reconciles exactly (347,241,007,583 + 46,764,263,175 = 394,005,270,758). Every P&L subtotal reconciles exactly.
